title: Suppress close-the-loop for docs-only feedback-loop features only via the inline kind-line marker

facts.note: Planner feature files are identifiable by path/kind.
Required: the kind: line value is readable from the feature file.
Required: source defines no mechanical test for 'docs-only'; judging requires reading the feature's scope.

values: planner intends to opt the feature out of close-the-loop (marker not yet written)
atdd:suppress(planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) marker added or present on kind: line
facts.note: Either alternative suffices; marker presence is optional. Intent before insertion is LLM-judged from the plan/task; marker presence itself is textually observable now.

fires: A planner authors or edits a docs-only feature with kind: feedback-loop and intends to opt it out of the close-the-loop rule, before any marker is written.
A docs-only feature with kind: feedback-loop carries (or gains) an atdd:suppress(...) marker for the close-the-loop rule.
doesNotFire: A feature whose kind is not feedback-loop.
A docs-only feedback-loop feature that neither carries a suppression marker nor is being opted out (close-the-loop applies normally).
A feedback-loop feature that is not docs-only: this permission does not activate; any suppression marker there is a misuse to be caught by the close-the-loop rule's own check, not by this rule.

given: A feature declared `kind: feedback-loop` whose deliverable is documentation only
when: the planner wants to opt the feature out of the close-the-loop rule
then: Write the suppression inline on the kind: line exactly as `kind: feedback-loop  # atdd:suppress(planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD`.
prefer: Use the suppression marker (the inline opt-out for docs-only feedback-loop features) with a concrete UNTIL date so the relief expires.
avoid: Suppressing close-the-loop on a feedback-loop feature that is not docs-only.
Placing the suppression anywhere other than the kind: line, or omitting the rule id or UNTIL date.
why: Docs-only feedback-loop features have no runtime loop to close, so a dated, inline, rule-specific opt-out is the sanctioned hatch that keeps the relief visible and time-bounded.
evidence: The feature's kind: line contains `# atdd:suppress(planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD` with a valid date.
The suppressed feature's scope is documentation only.
verifier_detail: Term suppression_marker: inline opt-out for docs-only feedback-loop features. Syntax: `kind: feedback-loop  # atdd:suppress(planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD`.
Graph: this rule relieves planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop (and planner.feature.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) until the UNTIL date.

additions.text: Avoid suppressing non-docs-only features, or placing/omitting parts of the marker.
additions.justification: Direct negation of the source's scope ('docs-only') and syntax; makes the boundary explicit for planners.
